page_title: WHU 0-1 EVE | West Ham v Everton 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' A clumsy foul by Tomas Soucek (West Ham) and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle.

90+1' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the left post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chermiti (Everton) replaces Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
88' The resulting corner, taken by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), comes to nothing.
87' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but Jordan Pickford punches the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.
85' Substitution. Aaron Cresswell leaves the pitch and is replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
83' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

78' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Jordan Pickford inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
76' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) gets booked.
76' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
73' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
73' Substitution. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) replaces James Ward-Prowse.
73' James Garner (Everton) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alphonse Areola with a measured shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
69' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
68' Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
68' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
67' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' The corner by Dwight McNeil (Everton) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

66' Dwight McNeil (Everton) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Alphonse Areola pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. Everton win a corner kick.
65' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
64' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul after James Tarkowski (Everton) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to West Ham.
62' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) but poses no threat.
61' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
61' Now Everton have a corner.

60' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola was alert and the score remained the same.
59' A short pass finds Edson Alvarez (West Ham). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
57' The substitution is prepared. Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Michail Antonio.
56' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take the free kick.

56' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) brings his opponent down. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to West Ham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

55' Close! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

51' 0 - 1 Goal! Jack Harrison slips a clever pass through to Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
50' An attempted cross from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is cleared.
49' Amadou Onana (Everton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
47' He should have scored! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Handball by James Garner (Everton).
44' Amadou Onana (Everton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
43' Amadou Onana (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and signals a foul after Amadou Onana (Everton) brought his opponent down.

40' What a chance! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
35' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
34' Jack Harrison (Everton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.

29' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
28' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) gets a yellow card.
28' Jordan Pickford (Everton) receives a yellow card.
26' Jack Harrison (Everton) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Alphonse Areola.
23' Lucas Paqueta plays a short pass through to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the right post.
21' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).
20' The linesman signals that Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
17' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is penalised for a foul. Stuart Attwell had a clear view and blows his whistle.
13' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
11' The corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is hurriedly cleared.

10' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after James Garner (Everton) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. West Ham win a free kick.
9' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford is quickest to intercept the ball.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Michail Antonio (West Ham).
6' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alphonse Areola intercepts the ball.
5' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) releases Michail Antonio with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
4' Michail Antonio (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
